title: Reply: evolution selects the neural causes, and the conscious events come with them

statements.text: The biology that embraces natural selection also says behavior has muscular and then neural causes, each link with an adequate physical cause. Kinds of neural event can be selected for, and conscious events, as their effects, are had because their neural causes were selected. If the neural causes are selected and sufficient, no further effect can be attributed to selection.

sources.quote: it fits well in their view that we have the conscious events we do because the neural causes of these events have been selected for
